description: Valid and invalid 2.2 sources outside the gate-1 corpus that declare their own packages named Swaml::Numeric, Swaml::Text or Swaml::Time (WP3 review F1): with operations named like the 2.3 intrinsics, empty, twice, next to another package declaring the same names, with types and components, used by import, by qualified name and by an operation usage, in initializers, guards and before a suspension. In 2.3 such a package hides the 2.3 library package of the same name (WP3-L04). Each parses with the kept 2.2 grammar. Their diagnostics (with related information), normalized ASTs and runs are recorded once from implementation 3.1.0 in recorded-wp3b.json and compared by scripts/compatibility-2-2-extended.mjs.

models.name: v1 user Swaml::Numeric with sqrt, used by import (review a1)
v2 user Swaml::Time with now (review a2)
v4 qualified user Swaml::Text::intText without import (review a4)
v5 user package Swaml::Numeric::Extra (review a9)
models.text:
package Swaml::Numeric::Extra { operation def f() returns int { return 1; } }
package App { import Swaml::Numeric::Extra; component def D { attribute x: int = f(); } component Demo: D; }
